expected_diagnosis: Root filesystem has no space available; logs occupy large part.
recommended_next_checks: Find largest safe-to-review files and log growth source.
resolution_guidance: Use approved rotation/cleanup or disk upgrade after backup.
verification: Available disk restored and app writes.
escalate_when: Unknown high-growth logs or data criticality.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
